question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.

One of Ram's __leisure __activities is tennis.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Recreation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"leisure"** means free time when one is not working and can engage in activities for enjoyment. (फुर्सत)

 
 
• **Example: **In his leisure time, he enjoys reading books and painting.
 
 
 
• **"Recreation" **refers to activities done for enjoyment when one is not working. (मनोरंजन)
 
 
• **Example: **One of her favorite recreations is playing the piano.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that a synonym for **'leisure' **is **'recreation'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Recreation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Main** (मुख्य): Most important or principal.

 
 
• **Example:** The main reason for his success is his hard work.
 
 
 
• **Lead** (नेतृत्व करना): To be in charge or command of.
 
 
• **Example: **She will lead the new project starting next month.
 
 
 
• **Languish** (मुरझाना): To become weak or feeble; to suffer neglect.
 
 
• **Example:** Plants will languish without enough sunlight and water.
